title: Ask the island.
logline: At dusk the quokka asks a question and the island answers from its own notes.

story.setup: Evening, and the quokka can't remember what's left before the trip.
story.turn: It opens Chat: an on-device model reads the vault and answers from what's actually there, naming the notes it read.
story.payoff: The answer keeps Conversation notes, the chat is saved as Markdown, and a PDF of the plan is filed beside it.

features.claim: Chat reads the vault you are in, or the note you started it from, and answers from what is actually there.
On-device by default, or through an official Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor client already installed on your Mac.
After every reply, rotli rewrites a short Conversation notes section. The chat itself is saved as Markdown too.
In the Mac app it can also make a Word document, a PDF, or a board, filed beside the chat.
Flip the globe for a web lookup.
